description: OpenAI Whisper large-v3-turbo running through the HuggingFace transformers library; a multilingual encoder-decoder speech transformer. Any Whisper checkpoint or local path can be substituted.
notes: Plugin default model; CUDA optional via 'use_cuda'. Langs pinned to the language set actually exercised in scoring (Whisper is auto-detect/multilingual by design, but an empty langs list made this fighter eligible against every board rather than only the ones it was evaluated on).
